tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1973 年发布
description: 美能达于1973年推出的旁轴相机。

specs.英文简介: The Minolta SR-T Super (SR-T 102 in USA and Canada, SR-T 303 elsewhere) is basically a Minolta SR-T 101, but with a hot shoe, a focusing screen with split-image rangefinder, multi-exposure capability, and the selected aperture value visible in the viewfinder.
